title: RunPlan
description: Which review dimensions a run intends to cover, in planned order (5.7 R40 scenario 2: dimension-aware context compression needs a plan to be aware of). Whoever configures the run produces this; whoever renders coverage reads it. Nothing in the kernel reads a config file to make one. NOTE ON SOURCE OF TRUTH: the id/label/focus constraints are duplicated from `src/dimension-context.ts`, which has no JSON Schema of its own — until that gap is closed, the zod side is the definition and this file mirrors it. ID-LEVEL UNIQUENESS IS ENFORCED BY ZOD ONLY: `uniqueItems` compares whole objects, so two entries with the same id but different focus pass this schema and are refused by `RunPlanSchema`.
